title: Solo Leveling
synopsis: After surviving a deadly dungeon, hunter Sung Jinwoo gains a power no one else has: the ability to grow stronger without limits. He sets out to uncover the mystery behind his new abilities and the gates appearing around the world.

title: Demon Slayer
synopsis: After a demon attack changes his family forever, Tanjiro joins the Demon Slayer Corps. He travels with his allies in search of a way to restore his sister and confront the demons threatening people across Japan.

title: Fullmetal Alchemist
synopsis: Brothers Edward and Alphonse Elric set out to restore what they lost in a forbidden alchemical experiment. Their search for the Philosopher's Stone leads them into a larger conspiracy woven through their country.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen
synopsis: Yuji Itadori enters the hidden world of jujutsu sorcerers after becoming the host of a powerful curse. At Tokyo Jujutsu High, he trains to fight curses while facing the danger within himself.

title: Vinland Saga
synopsis: Growing up amid Viking warfare, Thorfinn pursues a life shaped by revenge and survival. His journey across a turbulent era forces him to reconsider what strength, freedom, and peace mean.

title: Frieren
synopsis: Long after her party's great adventure ends, elf mage Frieren begins a new journey. Traveling with younger companions, she discovers how brief human lives can reshape the way she understands her own past.

title: Spy x Family
synopsis: To complete a mission for world peace, spy Twilight creates a pretend family. His new wife and daughter each have secrets of their own, turning everyday family life into an unpredictable operation.

title: Blue Lock
synopsis: After Japan's national team falls short, a bold training program gathers young strikers to compete for one place. Isagi must sharpen his instincts and ambition in a high-pressure fight to become the team's leading forward.

title: One Piece
synopsis: Monkey D. Luffy sails toward the Grand Line with a growing crew, searching for the legendary One Piece. Each island brings new allies, rival pirates, and another step toward his dream of becoming King of the Pirates.

title: Chainsaw Man
synopsis: After a desperate life as a devil hunter, Denji is brought back with the power to transform into Chainsaw Man. Recruited into a government unit, he faces devils while trying to build an ordinary life.

title: My Hero Academia
synopsis: In a world where superpowers are common, Izuku Midoriya pursues his dream of becoming a hero despite being born without a quirk. His path leads to U.A. High School and a new generation of heroes in training.

title: Attack on Titan
synopsis: Humanity lives behind enormous walls built to keep out the Titans. After a breach shatters that fragile safety, Eren Yeager and his friends join the fight and uncover truths that reshape their world.

title: Kusuriya no Hitorigoto 3rd Season
synopsis: Pharmacist Maomao returns to the inner court, where a small detail leads her into a new mystery. As questions ripple through the palace, her careful observations and partnership with Jinshi guide the investigation.
